//: Vesper hooks. MERGE these into your .claude/settings.json -- do NOT paste this file over yours. Prefer Merge-VesperHooks.ps1, which merges idempotently and validates. /vesper:vesper setup offers to run it for you.
//1: SessionStart carries the ENTIRE return leg. Without it, departure works and morning never comes.
//2: PostToolUse contains PLACEHOLDER_PROJECT_A|PLACEHOLDER_PROJECT_B -- replace with a regex matching YOUR deployable project paths, or the deploy guard never fires.
//3: The probe's own permission is granted by SKILL.md's allowed-tools frontmatter (${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}), not by a rule here -- there is nothing to hand-edit for it.

hooks.command: $in = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($in.tool_input.command -match 'git push') { $files = git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD 2>$null; if ($files -match 'PLACEHOLDER_PROJECT_A|PLACEHOLDER_PROJECT_B') { $v = $false; $root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null | Select-Object -First 1; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($root)) { $root = '.' }; $hp = Join-Path $root 'VESPER_HANDOFF.md'; if (Test-Path $hp) { $h = Get-Content $hp -Raw; if ($h -notmatch '(?m)^#.*status:\s*resolved') { $v = $true } }; if ($v) { $m = 'Vesper DEPARTURE leg (unattended): do NOT deploy. Deploying is outside the unattended autonomy boundary and the repo deploy convention is superseded until the handoff is resolved. Record a deferred action in VESPER_HANDOFF.md carrying the exact deploy command for the project(s) just pushed, then continue with the next ledger item. This notice binds the unattended leg ONLY: if the user is present and has asked for this deploy - the /vesper:vesper resume leg, where a deploy is one of only two things that clears the gate - it does not apply, so deploy and clear the gate.' } else { $m = 'Deployable project files were just pushed. Convention: deploy to the server now via that project''s deploy script, unless this push was already deployed.' }; @{hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='PostToolUse'; additionalContext=$m}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 5 } }
